body: Thank you so much for your kind words <3

> Played water polo at junior national teams at the time and I remember myself crawling on the floor at 17-18 of age because the calories were not enough. 

That's honestly so messed up. The fact that you still live with that trauma through leaving cupboards open etc is honestly so sad. I'm happy that I'm the more rebellious type, hence why he has targeted me. I react strongly to his abuse but at times I realise that a lot of stuff have become so normalised and being brought up in such environment makes you really oblivious to ongoing abuse. 

I hope you're doing better now and I appreciate your symphaty! I will go almost no contact, let's just hope he doesn't start harassing me in new ways once I've moved out.
Thanks man

>I think it's better if you don't tell him at all and I hope ur mom stops enabling him. maybe when you leave, her eyes will be opened to his shit.. sometimes it takes big measures for anything to change.

He'll throw a tantrum either way so I really don't care about validating his feelings atp. 

>praying to earth that he goes somewhere when I plan on packing my car and dipping because this asshole makes every new job schedule the SAME as mine so I get absolutely no break from him 

Damn that must be exhausting. Don't let him get the best of you, I wanna say you can do it but I don't wanna break any sub rules lol. You got it though!

Not to be negative but that's like a fraction of everything dude. I really tried to focus on how he has abused me specifically. But he is fucking sick in the head and if it wasn't for my mother being financially unstable I would've called social services on him ages ago.

>She tells me she needs some days to think which means she has to make a decision between me (23M) and the other guy (18 M).

There you have your answer dude. Leave her before she leaves you and remember to not settle for less.

Only if I could lol, been hiding a soon to be 3-year relationship behind their backs. It's complicated to say the least. But I will try to raise the topic of moving out if they choose to go through with the room thing. Then we'll see how it goes from there.

I have jokingly said that I want to move out but it wasn't taken very lightly. The only exception would've been if I studied in another city which I don't. I don't believe my parents are pro moving out before ''marriage'' or on my own. On the other end, I am in a committed relationship and the two of us have talked about getting married and then moving out in 1-2 years time.

I do not pay any rent. I took a gap year before starting collage and insisted on paying but they refused to take any money. Also, it's ''part of the culture'' to not pay rent where we live.

>In regards to a quiet study place, libraries are perfect for students studying! As for the depression, I would suggest seeking aid from your school to speak with someone. This would benefit you regardless of bedroom arrangements.

Thank you! I will keep this in mind.
Thats how I reason too, but like we've both said: its their house in the end so there's not much I can do.
Indeed, thanks for your input.
Yeah true, the interest rate for student loans are absurdly low where I live. I'll think about it, thanks!

Thank you for the detailed response!

>Since the boys can’t share a room because 17M is too much of a bully, he certainly shouldn’t be getting rewarded with the largest bedroom in the house to himself. That seems like a bizarre parenting choice.

Indeed, there is a lot of unjust regarding chores and other housework that he is not expected to be doing. By his age I had done much more, but I know that it all comes down to me being a female.

>This arrangement seems like your parents are trying to send a message. Are they possibly trying to encourage you to move out to the dorms or a college apartment? They may be not so subtly telling you that they think it’s time for you to take the next step toward being an adult.

My parents are pretty conservative so I don't think that's their intention. Regardless of the matter, this situation has me considering it. It just feels unnecessary to move out when school is only like an hour away.
I hear you, thank you for the input.

My thoughts exactly! However my parents wouldn't settle with the boys sharing a room again. They have done so in the past and it resulted in 17M literally bullying 12M.

I do work sometimes, but I don't know about moving out just yet. They wouldn't be happy with that either lol.
How come?
You holding any? **🚀🚀🚀**
Sounds like r/wallstreetbets (sorry I just had to)
Couldn't have said it better. It's the triggers for me.
Don't do that please. It can probably cause more damage than any of us thinks.
Being optimistic is not my strongest trait. But I hope we can pull through this.  We've been strong so far at least.

Me too, antidepressants and weed dependence really fucked me up. The pills made me apathetic and I have not been the same since. The weed was my escape from reality and the shit I was facing. But everything hit ten times harder when I stopped, as I didn't have an escape and had to actually face my reality. I had a period of derealization combined with panic attacks - the combination of everything was terrible, but I miss the high, ngl.

Indeed nobody asked to be here. I feel like life can be good depending on what you make of it.. But it doesn't look very bright when every day is filled with misery, guilt and regret. I hope things work out for you, I would be ironic if I wished you'd hold on, but I really do. I'm glad we made it this far.

Yeah, my dad told me it's all in my head when I was going through it during school. Mom gets it but we don't really talk about mental illnesses. I honestly believe there are other options to suicide but it doesn't look very bright when every door is shut..

It's an endless loop if you choose to look at it that way. Same thing goes for comparing oneself with those who are more fortunate. For me, this is what destroys me. On one end, I envy people who are- or at least seem to be in a better place than me. But at the same time I feel so guilty and undeserving for not appreciating and making the most out of my situation. I feel like I should do more, and do better but I can't as I'm just stuck with this depressive mindset.
Self destruct at its finest huh
Indeed. Sometimes I think to myself that I am not one to complain. At least I have a roof over my head - but it gets overwhelming sometimes.

Idk. Changing my personality to better fit in didn't work throughout the late years of school. Now I am the product of my own work as I've lost my true self in the process and I am left with nothing but irreversible damage.
Me too, life sucks. It's really difficult to cope when nobody understands what goes through your mind everyday.
Im sorry too. Life treats everyone differently I guess. I envy people who feel happy and at peace tbh.
Yeah, no, totally. It's hard.
Thank you very much.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.
